title: A merchant lists a business, links a building, sets an offer and a coupon, sees the figures and answers the pilot check-in

milestones.title: A free business profile is created and public
A lot is claimed for it in the city
The building is linked to the profile
The call to action is changed and published
A coupon is set in the storefront; an offer on the free plan asks for Pro
The dashboard shows the profile, its set-up steps and its figures
The operator adds the business to the pilot
The merchant sends the weekly check-in from the dashboard
The pilot dashboard has the check-in
